dow_investment.text: Q3-26 10-Q Note B: on 17-Apr-2026 Aerojet Rocketdyne Holdings (Missile Solutions) issued 10,000 shares of redeemable Series A convertible preferred stock (stated value $100,000 each; $1bn) and pre-/post-IPO warrants (3% of AXYV common stock, fully diluted) to the U.S. Department of War; net proceeds $973m to expand missile manufacturing capacity. Liquidation preference = face + 7% cumulative dividends compounded quarterly; automatic conversion into AXYV common stock at a 20% discount to the IPO price upon a Qualified IPO on or before 31-Dec-2027; otherwise conversion on demand or redemption on or after 17-Apr-2031. Mezzanine equity $987m at 2-Oct-2026 (initial $1,070m − $89m deferred tax − $27m costs + $33m deemed dividends), accreting to $1,422m by 17-Apr-2031 through deemed dividends. Conversion-feature derivative $203m and warrants $163m (fair value; changes in other non-operating income: −$50m in Q3-26). Program investment intangible asset $386m, amortized as a reduction of revenue over 20 years from Q3-26.

space_tech_sale.text: Q3-26 10-Q Note O: 60% controlling interest in the Space Technology disposal group (Space Propulsion and Power Systems product lines and the Space Avionics & Communications division; Missile Solutions) sold 3-Aug-2026 for $539m net cash; retained 40% of RocketForce Technologies LLC ("Rocketdyne") recorded as a $248m equity-method investment; pre-tax losses $27m in 9M 2026 (+ $54m in fiscal 2025). Disposal-group revenue 2025: $571m; Q1-26 $157m, Q2-26 $155m, Q3-26 $38m (earnings appendix).

debt.at_2026_10_02: Q3-26 10-Q Note I: fixed-rate debt $10,776m + finance leases and other $265m − unamortized discounts / costs $45m = $10,996m; current portion $1,815m ($550m 3.85% notes due Dec-2026 and $1,250m 5.40% notes due Jan-2027); no commercial paper outstanding ($2.5bn programme backed by the 2025 Five-Year Credit Facility maturing 18-Feb-2030). $100m 7.00% debentures repaid 14-Jan-2026.
debt.new_notes: 8-K 5-Nov-2026: $500m 5.200% notes due 2029 and $500m 5.400% notes due 2032 issued 5-Nov-2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/202058/000020205826000089/hrs-20261102.htm).

buyback.text: Q3-26 10-Q: $3.0bn authorization (announced 21-Oct-2022; no expiration); 1.8m shares repurchased for $598m in 9M 2026; $1,629m remaining at 2-Oct-2026. Q3-26: 259,000 shares at $282.50 (fiscal August). 186,144,686 shares issued and outstanding at 2-Oct-2026.

dividend.text: Quarterly dividend raised to $1.25 from $1.20 on 23-Jan-2026 (25th consecutive annual increase); $704m paid in 9M 2026 (Q3-26 10-Q).

pension.text: Q3-26 10-Q: net defined benefit plan assets of $1.4bn at 2-Oct-2026; no material contributions expected in fiscal 2026. Non-service FAS pension income $224m in 9M 2026 ($74m in Q3).
